description: This file defines a class 'Functions' with static methods for matrix operations such as validation, calculation of adjoint, cofactors, determinant, minors, trace, transpose, and inverse. It also includes public methods to calculate adjoint, cofactors, minors, trace, identity, inverse, and diagonal/anti-diagonal matrices.

classes.name: Functions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for matrix calculations such as validation, adjoint, cofactors, determinant, minors, trace, transpose, inverse, and generating special matrices.

methods.name: validateMatrix
methods.description: Validates that the input is a Matrix object or converts an array to a Matrix.

methods.name: getAdjoint
methods.description: Calculates the adjoint (classical adjoint) of a square matrix.

methods.name: adjoint
methods.description: Public method to get the adjoint of a matrix or array, with validation and square matrix check.

methods.name: getCofactors
methods.description: Calculates the cofactors of a matrix based on its minors.

methods.name: cofactors
methods.description: Public method to get cofactors of a square matrix.

methods.name: getDeterminantSegment
methods.description: Calculates a sub-determinant of the matrix by removing specified row and column.

methods.name: getDeterminant
methods.description: Recursively calculates the determinant of a matrix.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Public method to get the determinant of a matrix or array.

methods.name: diagonal
methods.description: Returns the main diagonal of a square matrix.

methods.name: antidiagonal
methods.description: Returns the anti-diagonal (secondary diagonal) of a square matrix.

methods.name: identity
methods.description: Returns an identity matrix of the same size as the input matrix.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates and returns the inverse of a matrix, with validation for square and non-zero determinant.

methods.name: getMinors
methods.description: Calculates the minors of a matrix for cofactor calculations.

methods.name: minors
methods.description: Public method to get the minors of a square matrix.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Calculates the trace of a square matrix.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Returns the transpose of a matrix.
